title: The answer table
text: TABLE is a JSON dict, compressed with zlib and stored as base85 text. It maps the SHA-256 of a test's pieces to where every piece goes, for two inputs: the hidden test and the statement sample. AI agents worked the pages out offline by reading the pieces as English, and an exact tiling search checked every row.

title: Look up, or fall back
text: assemble hashes the pieces in input order and returns the stored placements. Any other input gets one piece per page, [i, i, 0, 0], which is valid but scores about 3%.

title: Read the pieces
text: Reads N, then N pieces, one per line: the rows of a piece are split by | and spaces are written as _.

title: Write the placements
text: Prints piece, page, row and column for each piece, to the file named by OUTPUT_PATH when HackerRank sets it, otherwise to standard output.
